title: Optimized Modpack but good
description: Removes annoyances, makes the game more like 1.8
body:
Modpack for 1.21.11 with my default mods and settings. Eventually I'll make a version of this that's good and meant for more than just my friends.
- Includes optimization mods
- Good default video settings
- Makes the in-game animations like those found in 1.8.9
- Makes the main menu look like beta
- F5 Change Camera View -> R
- Removed annoyances like all popups, warning screens, notifications, etc
